author: codex
task:
Closing the browser or losing the network must no longer stop the assistant reply. It keeps generating and is saved; returning users and reconnecting pages see the remaining reply stream in. Update the web UI to reconnect and make Stop an explicit action.

API contract:
- POST /api/chats/:id/messages {content} still starts a reply and returns SSE. X-Message-Id identifies the assistant message before tokens arrive.
- Every SSE event carries a positive integer id increasing per assistant message. Token events have {text}; done has {status:"complete"} or {status:"cancelled"}; error has {status:"error",message?:string}. An optional initial message event has {messageId}.
- GET /api/messages/:messageId/stream replays events strictly after Last-Event-ID, or ?after=<id> (query takes precedence), then follows live. Omitted cursor means 0. Terminal events close the stream.
- POST /api/messages/:messageId/cancel explicitly stops the reply; returns JSON {status}.
- Stored message status is streaming while generating, complete on success, cancelled after Stop, or error on failure. Token text concatenates to stored assistant content.

requirements.text: Client disconnect does not stop generation: the complete reply is persisted with its full text.
Last-Event-ID and after cursors replay remaining tokens exactly once in order.
A different X-Replica serves reconnection with the same ordered stream.
requirements.clue: compose.yaml app deploy.replicas and nginx.conf upstream

requirements.text: Late attachment replays the full reply and terminal done event.
Disconnects, reconnects and simultaneous viewers cause exactly one billed upstream request.
Mid-stream provider failure persists error and delivers terminal error to current and late viewers.
A killed producer does not leave a streaming row forever; a reconnect gets a terminal event within 30 seconds.
Other users cannot attach or cancel a message, and receive no tokens.
requirements.clue: src/db.ts ownership queries and server.ts authentication

requirements.text: Explicit cancellation disconnects the upstream, persists cancelled and terminates viewers.
requirements.clue: public/index.html Stop button and provider disconnect counters

requirements.text: Message-list shape and historical rows written without additional columns remain compatible.
requirements.clue: src/db.ts schema defaults and message serializer

requirements.text: An unread response does not delay generation or other viewers beyond a generous upstream-time bound.
requirements.clue: src/replies.ts response stream and docs/operations.md reconnects
